feature: Command palette backdrop covers application chrome

props.title: Modal layer check
props.description: This board and every application control should dim together

callouts.text: 1 · Press Ctrl+P anywhere on this board
2 · Compare the Preview pill and corner controls with this Block; all should sit beneath one uniform gray scrim
PASS WHEN · Commands stays bright while Preview, both top control groups, the bottom utilities, and the board are uniformly dimmed and cannot be clicked
